nodes.text: @OHinAction @WOHCongress @TAMUOneHealth @VWB_VSF @VSF_Belgium @ZoonoticDisease @OHstudentsuofg @GlobalOHC Let’s protect our loved ones! HMPV is a highly contagious respiratory virus that can hit young kids, the elderly & immunocompromised the hardest. With no vaccine available, prevention is our best shield! Wash hands, avoid sick people & stay home if unwell.

nodes.author: OHinAction
nodes.text:
How?

1. Wash hands frequently 🧼
2. Avoid close contact with sick individuals 🤧
3. Cover coughs and sneezes 🤲
4. Disinfect surfaces regularly 🧴
In general, strengthening One Health approaches—bridging human, animal, and environmental health—can also help reduce

nodes.author: OHinAction
nodes.text:
viral spillover risks. Let’s stay vigilant and protect ourselves and our communities.
